stories.headline: Trump Pauses Hormuz Reopening, US and Gulf Allies Propose New UN Resolution Threatening Iran

key_facts.fact: Trump announced Tuesday evening he was pausing the U.S. effort to guide stranded vessels out of the Strait of Hormuz to allow time for a deal to end the Iran war, while the blockade of Iranian ports remains in place.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. President Donald Trump said Tuesday evening he was pausing the U.S. effort to guide stranded vessels out of the Strait of Hormuz to allow time for a deal to end the Iran war, but that the American forces' blockade of the Iranian ports would remain in place.

key_facts.fact: The US drafted a new UN Security Council resolution with Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, and Qatar that could lead to sanctions or potentially authorize force against Iran if it fails to halt attacks on shipping.
key_facts.excerpt: The United States and its Gulf allies have proposed a U.N. resolution threatening Iran with sanctions or other measures if it doesn't halt attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz, stop imposing 'illegal tolls,' and disclose the placement of all mines.

key_facts.fact: Rubio called the resolution 'a real test to the U.N.' and urged China and Russia not to repeat their vetoes of a previous Hormuz resolution last month.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Tuesday called a U.S.-proposed U.N. resolution demanding Iran stop attacks and laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz a test of the utility of the United Nations and urged China and Russia not to repeat vetoes.

key_facts.fact: Pentagon chief Hegseth and Gen. Dan Caine said Iran's attacks remain 'below the threshold of restarting major combat operations' and insist the ceasefire still holds.
key_facts.excerpt: General Dan Caine, the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, said Iran attacked Oman once on Monday and waged three attacks on the United Arab Emirates... However, the attacks fell 'below the threshold of restarting major combat operations at this point.'

key_facts.fact: Caine estimated 22,500 mariners on more than 1,550 commercial vessels remain stuck in the Gulf, unable to transit the strait.
key_facts.excerpt: Caine estimated 22,500 mariners embarked on more than 1,550 commercial vessels were stuck in the Gulf, unable to transit.

key_facts.fact: Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi traveled to Beijing on Wednesday to meet Chinese counterpart Wang Yi — the first such visit since the start of the war.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met with his Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, in Beijing on Wednesday morning... It was the first time since the start of the war that Araghchi has traveled to China.

key_facts.fact: Washington also circulated a proposal for a new multinational Maritime Freedom Construct (MFC) to establish a post-conflict security architecture for the Middle East.
key_facts.excerpt: Washington has also circulated a proposal, seen by Reuters, to partners for a new multinational maritime coalition, the Maritime Freedom Construct (MFC), aimed at establishing a post-conflict security architecture for the Middle East.

stories.headline: Samsung Reaches $1 Trillion Valuation, Only Second Asian Company After TSMC to Hit Mark

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics reached a market valuation of 1,500 trillion won (~$1.03 trillion) in Seoul trading on May 6, as shares soared 14.4% to an all-time high.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics has reached a US$1 trillion market valuation... The milestone came as the South Korean company's shares soared 14.4 per cent to an all-time high on May 6.

key_facts.fact: Samsung became only the second Asian company after TSMC to reach the $1 trillion market cap milestone, and the 13th company globally to join the 'trillion club.'
key_facts.excerpt: The market capitalisation of Samsung Electronics' common stock surpassed $1 trillion on Wednesday, making it the second Asian company after TSMC to reach the milestone.

key_facts.fact: The rally pushed South Korea's Kospi benchmark above the 7,000 level for the first time, with the index surging 6.45% to close at 7,384.56.
key_facts.excerpt: The Kospi closed above the 7,000 level for the first time on May 6, surging 6.45 per cent to 7,384.56.

key_facts.fact: Samsung's stock has risen around 300% over the past year, driven by booming AI chip demand. The company reported record Q1 operating profit surging 750% YoY to 57.2 trillion won (~$39.3B).
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung's shares have risen around 300 per cent over the past year as the AI boom boosts South Korean growth... operating profit surged 750 per cent on-year to a record first-quarter high of 57.2 trillion won.

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix also hit a record high, leaping 10.6%. Samsung and SK Hynix together account for 44% of the Kospi's total value.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung and its memory peer SK Hynix, which leapt 10.6 per cent to a record, together account for 44 per cent of the Kospi benchmark index's total value.

stories.headline: Von der Leyen Tells Trump 'A Deal Is a Deal' as EU Unites Against Car Tariff Threat

key_facts.fact: European Commission President von der Leyen spoke out for the first time since Trump's Friday announcement of 25% tariffs on EU cars, stating flatly that 'a deal is a deal.'
key_facts.excerpt: Speaking out for the first time since Trump's Friday announcement that he would impose 25 percent tariffs on EU-made automobiles, von der Leyen flatly stated that 'a deal is a deal.'

key_facts.fact: French President Macron explicitly backed retaliation, saying 'the EU has the tools to respond, and should use them, because that's what they are for.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'If a country is threatened with fresh tariffs, the EU has the tools to respond, and should use them, because that's what they are for,' he said.

key_facts.fact: Under the Turnberry accord struck last July, US tariffs on EU cars were set at 15%. In exchange, the EU agreed to lower industrial tariffs, purchase $750 billion in US energy, and invest $600 billion in the American economy.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the terms of the agreement struck last July, U.S. tariffs on European cars were set at 15 percent. In exchange, Brussels agreed to lower industrial tariffs, purchase $750 billion in U.S. energy and invest $600 billion in the American economy.

key_facts.fact: EU Trade Commissioner Šefčovič met US Trade Representative Greer in Paris on Tuesday to try to steady talks after Trump's tariff threat.
key_facts.excerpt: Šefčovič was due to meet U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer in Paris on Tuesday in a fresh attempt to steady talks after Trump's tariff threat rattled transatlantic trade relations.

key_facts.fact: European Council President António Costa said EU leaders 'fully support' the Commission's response to Trump's trade threat.
key_facts.excerpt: European Council President António Costa said EU leaders 'fully support' the Commission's response to Trump's latest trade threat.

sources.title: 'A deal is a deal': Von der Leyen fires back at Trump over auto tariff threat

stories.headline: China's State-Backed Big Fund Seeks to Lead DeepSeek's First Fundraising at ~$45B Valuation

key_facts.fact: China's biggest state-backed semiconductor investment fund (Big Fund) is in talks to lead DeepSeek's first external fundraising round at a valuation of approximately $45 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: China's biggest state-backed semiconductor investment fund is in talks to lead the first fundraising round for AI startup DeepSeek... The potential deal could value the frontier AI lab at about $45 billion.

key_facts.fact: The valuation has surged from about $20 billion expected just weeks earlier when fundraising talks began, more than doubling in that period.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek's valuation has increased significantly in just a few weeks, up from the $20 billion expected when it started fundraising talks earlier.

key_facts.fact: Other investors still in talks for a stake include Chinese tech giants Tencent and Alibaba. Founder Liang Wenfeng, who controls 89.5% of the company, may also invest personal funds in the round.
key_facts.excerpt: Other investors still in talks for a stake include Chinese tech giants Tencent and Alibaba.

key_facts.fact: The Big Fund has previously backed key Chinese chipmakers like SMIC and Yangtze Memory Technologies, but has not publicly backed any large language model developer before — marking a strategic expansion of its mandate.
key_facts.excerpt: The fund's mandate is primarily focused on the silicon side of the AI stack, fabs, foundries, memory producers, and EDA tooling. This indicates a significant extension of the fund's mission.

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek had previously rejected all venture capital and never raised external funding since its founding.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek, which has repeatedly rejected venture capital, now plans to raise no less than $300 million in external funds.

stories.headline: Freshworks Cuts 11% of Workforce (~500 Jobs) as CEO Says 'Over Half of Code Is Written by AI'

key_facts.fact: Freshworks announced it would cut 11% of its workforce, about 500 jobs globally, citing AI-driven automation as a key driver. One-time restructuring charges of ~$8 million are expected.
key_facts.excerpt: Freshworks said on Tuesday it would cut 11% of its workforce, or about 500 jobs, as the business-software company grapples with an industry being reshaped by artificial intelligence.

key_facts.fact: CEO Dennis Woodside told Reuters the decision was driven by AI use in product and engineering: 'Over half of our code is written by AI,' reducing 'rote work that technology can take care of.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Over half of our code is written by AI,' Woodside said, adding that automation had reduced 'rote work that technology can take care of.'

key_facts.fact: The cuts follow Atlassian slashing roughly 10% of jobs last month. AI tools from Anthropic and others are seen as potential existential threats to traditional software makers.
key_facts.excerpt: The cuts are the latest tied to AI in the software sector... Peer Atlassian, last month, said it would slash roughly 10% of jobs. At the same time, AI tools from the likes of Anthropic are seen as potential existential threats to traditional software makers.

key_facts.fact: Freshworks' stock has declined about 26% in 2026. Despite the cuts, Q1 revenue rose 16% to $228.6 million, beating estimates of $223.24 million.
key_facts.excerpt: The San Mateo, California-based company's stock has declined about 26% this year... In the first quarter, revenue rose 16% to $228.6 million, compared with estimates of $223.24 million.

key_facts.fact: Layoffs.fyi reports that 92,462 tech employees globally have lost their jobs in 2026 so far. This is Freshworks' second restructuring in two years, after cutting 13% of staff in 2024.
key_facts.excerpt: Layoffs.fyi, a website that tracks tech job cuts around the world, reported that 92,462 employees have lost their jobs this year.

sources.title: Freshworks to cut 11% jobs as AI reshapes software sector
Freshworks to lay off 11% staff despite beating Q1 revenue estimates

stories.headline: Thailand Approves $12.2B Emergency Loan Decree to Cushion Hormuz-Driven Energy Crisis

key_facts.fact: Thailand's Cabinet approved a draft emergency decree to borrow up to 400 billion baht (~$12.2 billion), aimed at cushioning economic impacts from the global energy crisis and accelerating clean energy transition.
key_facts.excerpt: Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Tuesday (May 5) that the Cabinet has approved a draft emergency decree to borrow up to 400 billion baht (about US$12.2 billion), aimed at cushioning economic impacts from the global energy crisis.

key_facts.fact: PM Anutin said the decision was driven by the West Asia conflict (Hormuz disruption), which has cascaded from energy into food prices, putting significant pressure on the cost of living.
key_facts.excerpt: Anutin said the decision was driven by the ongoing West Asia conflict, which has disrupted global energy prices and economic activity, noting that the crisis has cascaded from energy into food prices.

key_facts.fact: Phase 1 provides immediate financial relief to farmers, SMEs, and low- to middle-income citizens. Phase 2 targets long-term transformation by reducing fossil fuel reliance and promoting renewables and EVs.
key_facts.excerpt: The first phase providing immediate financial relief to farmers, small- and medium-sized enterprises, and low- to middle-income citizens... The second phase seeks long-term structural transformation by reducing fossil fuel reliance, promoting renewable energy and electric vehicles.

key_facts.fact: The government aims to prevent Thailand from sliding into stagflation — high inflation combined with a slowing economy. National debt will remain below the 70% of GDP legal ceiling.
key_facts.excerpt: Anutin said the government's timely intervention is critical to prevent the Thai economy from sliding into stagflation... national debt will remain manageable and stay well below the legal ceiling of 70 per cent of gross domestic product.

key_facts.fact: The emergency decree is scheduled to be submitted to Parliament on May 14.
key_facts.excerpt: The emergency decree is scheduled to be submitted to the Parliament on May 14.

sources.title: Thai Cabinet approves emergency loan decree for energy crisis, green transition

stories.headline: Ukraine Doubles Medium-Range Drone Strikes, Hits Russian Defense Factories 1,500 km Away

key_facts.fact: Zelenskiy said on Tuesday that Ukrainian medium-range drone strikes at ranges of more than 20 km have doubled compared to March and quadrupled since February, calling it 'a priority area.'
key_facts.excerpt: Zelenskiy said on Tuesday that strikes at ranges of more than 20 km have doubled compared to March and quadrupled since February. 'And there will be even more,' he wrote on X. 'This is a priority area.'

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's Defence Ministry said forces conducted more than 160 medium-range strikes in April at ranges of 120-150 km, hitting 65+ logistics depots, 33 drone control points, and 17 command posts.
key_facts.excerpt: Kyiv's Defence Ministry said last week that Ukrainian forces had conducted more than 160 middle strikes throughout April at a range of 120-150 km. Targets included more than 65 logistics and ammunition depots, 33 drone control points and workshops, as well as 17 troop command posts.

key_facts.fact: Zelenskiy said Ukraine hit Russian military-industrial sites including defense manufacturing facilities in Cheboksary, 1,500 km away, using domestically developed Flamingo cruise missiles.
key_facts.excerpt: On Tuesday, Zelenskiy said Ukraine hit Russian military-industrial sites including defence manufacturing facilities in the city of Cheboksary, some 1,500 km away, using its domestically developed Flamingo cruise missiles.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's drone forces commander said his units struck 25 air-defense and 13 radar/electronic warfare systems in April to 'open corridors for ramping up deep strikes.'
key_facts.excerpt: Robert Brovdi, the commander of Ukraine's drone forces, said his units had struck 25 air-defence and 13 radar and electronic warfare systems in April to help pave the way for Kyiv's long-range campaign.

key_facts.fact: The campaign aims to reduce reliance on Western aid as Ukraine develops its homegrown defense sector, while Russian forces increase pressure on key fortified cities in eastern Ukraine.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukraine is embracing medium-range strikes as it develops its homegrown defence sector and seeks to wean itself off reliance on Western aid.

sources.title: Ukraine steps up medium-range strikes on Russian forces
